hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tighter text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-slate-500

visual enhancers.surfaces: Crystal Glass for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5). Solid matte white for activity cards with 1px delicate borders.
visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm (ambient) for cards, and shadow-md with translate-y for hover states.
visual enhancers.borders: Exposed grid borders for technical elegance. Use 1px border-black/10.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the background (opacity 2%) to give a 'premium digital paper' feel.
visual enhancers.print_styles: MANDATORY: Add a robust @media print section. Hide navigation, tabs, and buttons. Remove background colors. Force text to solid black and expand all agenda details for clean A4 printing.

grids.page_layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mobile-first one column.
grids.bento_spacing: gap-4 md:gap-8. Use generous padding (p-6 or p-8) inside containers.

layouts.general: Mobile-first approach. Optical alignment over geometric.
layouts.navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar for mobile (Agenda, Distances, Documents). Fixed left sidebar or top right for desktop.
layouts.header: Sticky top header containing the Day selector (horizontal scrollable list of 20 days). Must have glassmorphism.
layouts.agenda_flow: Vertical timeline. Group activities by Morning, Afternoon, Evening using subtle left-border color-coding.
layouts.activity_item: Flex row. Left: Time (Mono font). Right: Details (Title, Description, Link button).

motion.hover_states: Hover on activity: bg-slate-50, slight transform -translate-y-0.5.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in and slight slide-up for agenda items using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast guidelines. Text over backgrounds must be clearly legible.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for day selectors, navigation icons, and the print button.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='day-tab-1', data-testid='print-agenda-btn', data-testid='nav-documents').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react with Duotone or Light weights for a sophisticated, airy look.

3d libraries: None. Keep the interface ultra-clean, 2D, and document-focused to maintain professional elegance.

image urls.description: Elegant minimal desk setup with an iPad, perfect for a subtle hero image or auth background if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure the app perfectly parses a YAML configuration file to generate the 20 days and their respective activities. Use 'yaml' or 'js-yaml' library.
2. The UI must be highly optimized for mobile devices, functioning like a sleek native app (use safe-area-insets, hide scrollbars on the day horizontal list).
3. Build the day selector as a horizontally scrollable container with sticky position at the top.
4. For the 'Print' feature, use window.print() and ensure you write custom @media print CSS in index.css to format the agenda clearly on paper.
5. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the agenda items; build custom flat, rectangular HTML/Tailwind items with elegant left-border timeline accents.
6. Add a routing system (React Router) to handle the multi-page menu (Agenda, Distances, Documents).
7. Implement all specified typography and colors precisely. Use Cormorant Garamond for elegant section titles.
8. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent white.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Avoid default Inter/Roboto for headings.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for structure and reading flow.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus, etc).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Cramped layouts look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
